profile.headline: Senior Software Developer

positions.title: Business Analyst and Quality Assurance Specialist
Project Manager
positions.description:
• Lead company product to become #1 bestseller reverse osmosis water system on Amazon by developing and integrating new or revised business process for improved efficiency, availability of data, and standardization across the company.  
• Facilitate seller relationship with Amazon, Sears, Overstock, and Newegg management daily
• Executed extensive market research to identify emerging market trends and introduce creative and unique marketing strategies
• Use strong analytical abilities and take the initiative to identify business problems, opportunities, and solutions through analysis that is candid, timely and accurate
• Directed in introducing email campaigns to implement increasing online revenue sales
• Exhibited the ability to gain customer trust, and provide exceptional follow-up, leading to increased positive feedback and referral business
• Constructed and monitoring social media outlets to communicate and assist clients. 
• Assist shipping department communication with ULINE
